severity_notes: Southwest monsoon: High swell, discharge delays, anchorage queues at Paradip & Haldia.
Post-monsoon Bay of Bengal cyclone season: Port evacuations and berth operational halts.
Pre-monsoon depression risk in Bay of Bengal: Temporary lightering halts at Sagar/Sandheads.
Southern hemisphere cyclone season: Heavy rainfall causing rail & port loading delays at Newcastle.
Tropical rain season: High moisture content in coal, river barge delays at Samarinda.
Low river water levels: Reduced barge draft capacities along Mahakam river.
Heavy winter sea swells: TMT coal terminal loading interruptions at Richards Bay.
South-West Indian Ocean cyclone activity: Channel transit and berthing delays at Maputo.
Peak Atlantic hurricane activity: Vessel queueing and port closures at Hampton Roads/Norfolk.
Freezing conditions: Rail transport slowdowns for export coal to Norfolk.
